why: The only major reviewer in the results (What Hi-Fi) is about Blu-ray players, not NAS. Everything else is affiliate roundups, a Newegg buying guide, and one Australian niche review of the TS-464; they mention HDMI as a side bullet on general Plex-NAS lists rather than answering "which NAS has HDMI and plays to a TV." Nobody tests the HDMI playback itself or lists the HDMI-equipped models side by side. A focused page comparing HDMI NAS units on player software, HDR/audio support and price would stand out.
